meta.parties: Mariam Beevi Et Al v. Ruqqiah Umma

rules.statement: In cases where an executor fails and the Court is required to appoint someone else to administer the estate according to the testator's will, a Court should exercise its discretion with due regard to the claims and wishes of those legatees or devisees who have the greatest interest in the estate.
rules.supporting_quote: "In such cases, the principles of the English Law would be applicable under the Charter of 1833 except to the extent, if any, to which they are found to be inconsistent with the provisions of our local statutes. Section 519 (1) of the Civil Procedure Code directs a Court, in exercising its discretion, to pay regard to considerations of 'consanguinity, amount of interest, the safety of the estate, and the probability that it will be safely administered'."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 519 (1) of the Civil Procedure Code
